BrochureContent.Content:
O’Mahony Walsh are delighted to present this impressive 
five-bedroom, detached bungalow, situated on expansive 2.3 acre site, in the sought after address of Waterfall, Cork.

Extending to c.136 sq.m., with two reception rooms , two bathrooms and 5 bedrooms, Sraleigh will suit both home makers & investors alike. 

The large site and prime location offer an of abundance potential for a range of uses.  
Situated within walking distance of Corbally preschool, Ballinora Primary school & GAA club, and just 5km from Ballincollig and 10km from Cork city centre

ACCOMMODATION

Hallway – 3.55 X 2.44 
Accessed from a glass panelled PVC front door, the entrance hallway, complete with practical timber flooring and proves access to all accommodation.
___________________________________________________________________________
Living Room– 5.29m x 3.23m 
This carpeted living room boasts a front aspect, picture window and features an open fire with mahogany mantel piece. 
______________________________________________________________________________
Kitchen–Dining 4.80m x 3.84m 
A Shaker-style kitchen enjoys a rear aspect window and sliding door overlooking the garden. It offers ample storage and generous counter space, equipped with an integrated dishwasher and extractor fan. 
Fitted with spotlights and a combination of laminate floors in living/ dining area and lino in the kitchen. 
_________________________________________________________________________________

Bedroom 1–  4.03m x 3.45m 
Double bedroom with front aspect window,  timber laminate flooring, wardrobes & double bed frame.

______________________________________________________________________________

Bedroom 2–  3.38m x 3.45m 
Spacious double bedroom  with front aspect window, carpet flooring, wardrobes & double bed frame.

___________________________________________________________________________________


Bathroom - 3.18m x 2.65m 
A main bathroom & utility space, fitted with washing machine & tumble dryer. Tiled flooring, WC, WHB, Shower and sink with large vanity cabinet. 
_______________________________________________________________________________
Bathroom 2 – 2.65m x 1.87m 
A second shower room with lino flooring, WC, WHB & rear aspect window. 
_____________________________________________________________________________________
Bedroom 3 - 3.69m x 3.45m 
A well-appointed double bedroom with built in wardrobes,  carpet flooring and front aspect window. 




Bedroom 4  - 2.89m x 2.65m
Comfortable double bedroom with timber laminate flooring, built in wardrobes, side aspect window. 





Bedroom 5 – 3.51m x 2.65m
Double bedroom  with rear aspect window, carpet flooring, built in wardrobes & double bed frame.



_______________________________________________________________________________________


GARDEN DETAILS
Perched on a c.2.3 acre site, laid to expansive lawns, and mature tress to the rear. 
There is a block built garage adjacent to the house.

•	Impressive five-bedroom bungalow 
•	Set on a large 2.3 acre site
•	Superb countryside location walking distance to Ballinora village 
•	Just minutes from Ballincollig & Cork city
•	Spacious accommodation extending to approx. 136 sq.m. 
•	Well maintained rear and front gardens 
•	Ideal outdoor areas for relaxation and al fresco dining
